title: Assertio Holdings, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-21
summary: Assertio Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 21, 2026, disclosing that Garda Therapeutics intends to commence a tender offer on April 29, 2026 to purchase all outstanding shares of Assertio common stock. The tender offer follows a merger agreement signed April 8, 2026.
key_points: Assertio Holdings, Inc. (ticker: ASRT) is a Delaware corporation registered on Nasdaq with ticker ASRT.
Garda Therapeutics, Inc. signed an Agreement and Plan of Merger with Assertio on April 8, 2026.
Garda will launch a tender offer for all outstanding Assertio shares on April 29, 2026, following the expiration of the 20-day 'window-shop' period.
The filing is submitted under Item 7.01 (Regulation FD Disclosure) and Item 9.01 (Financial Statements and Exhibits).
Sam Schlessinger, Executive Vice President and General Counsel, signed the filing on April 21, 2026.
